metrics.window_convention: WP-12aw / WP-S2c-14 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, 2023-04-12 through 2024-04-11, as the first additional H-001 exp_success_criteria observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.
